plainName: Setting off a loss within the same head of income
summary: A loss from one source under a head is set against income from another source under the same head in the same year — for example, a loss on one house against income from another house.

routes.name: One house's loss against another house's income
routes.description: Each house's income or loss is worked out, and they are added together under the head.

disqualifiers.description: Losses on capital assets follow their own rules within the capital-gains head, which is not computed here yet.

enforcedBy.reason: the capital-gains head is planned for a later item
